text:
Zara - New Hire: Hi team, unboxed my MacBook Air and during the setup assistant I accepted the company enrollment but now System Settings shows 'MDM: pending' and FileVault is greyed out. Also the installer for Docker Desktop says I need admin. Anyone know who to ping? :wave:
Miles (IT): Welcome Zara! If you accepted enrollment it usually lands within a few minutes. Can you paste the serial and run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status`?
Zara - New Hire: Serial: M2ZARAX12345
Zara - New Hire: profiles: No enrolled profiles
Zara - New Hire: fdesetup: FileVault is Off
Support Bot: Created ticket ONB-7722 assigned to eng-infra. ETA ~90m.
Rory - EngInfra: Hi Zara  run `sudo log show --predicate 'process == "mdmclient"' --last 10m | tail -n 30` and paste the last lines. Also did you use Okta SSO or a local account at first boot?
Zara - New Hire: Used Okta SSO during setup. Pasting log snippet: "mdmclient: http error 403 - device not found"
Rory - EngInfra: 403 typically means the serial isn't linked to our ABM/DEP or Jamf needs a resync. Bea, can People Ops confirm if this serial was pre-registered?
Bea (People Ops): Checking inventory now. If it's not in ABM we can either ask procurement to upload (24-48h) or do a temporary bootstrap profile. Which do you prefer?
Zara - New Hire: Need to start dev tasks today if possible. A temp bootstrap + admin would be great.
Miles (IT): We can grant temporary local admin for 4 hours. Bea, approve?
Bea (People Ops): Approved. Temporary admin created for zara@redwood.com, expires in 4h. You should see admin under System Settings -> Users & Groups after logout/login.
Zara - New Hire: I see the admin flag and can `sudo`. Installed Homebrew and Docker. Thanks!
Rory - EngInfra: Sending DM with a link to a bootstrap mobileconfig. After you install that we'll push a FileVault enable command. Run `sudo profiles install -type configuration -path ~/Downloads/zara-bootstrap.mobileconfig` once downloaded.
Zara - New Hire: Done. `profiles status` now shows a profile named "redwood-bootstrap."
Rory - EngInfra: Great. FileVault policy pushed; restart when you see the prompt. We'll coordinate with People Ops to add the serial to ABM permanently and then replace the bootstrap profile with the DEP-managed one.
Support Bot: ONB-7722 updated: bootstrap profile applied; FileVault enable queued; temp admin active. EngInfra to follow up on ABM mapping.
Zara - New Hire: Restarted and FileVault shows "Enabling". Also ran `ssh-add` and fixed permissions with `chmod 700 ~/.ssh` as suggested in the handbook. All dev tools working.
Bea (People Ops): Procurement confirms vendor uploaded serial to ABM; eng-infra will swap profiles. Temporary admin will be revoked once DEP profile applied.
Rory - EngInfra: Confirmed: DEP profile applied and bootstrap removed. FileVault completed and recovery key escrowed. Revoking temp admin now.
Support Bot: ONB-7722 resolved: DEP enrollment completed, FileVault enabled, temporary admin revoked. If anything else, reply here or reopen the ticket.
Zara - New Hire: All set  thanks everyone! :rocket:
